Success criteria: All three bottles must be inside the trash can's storage area, lowered below tabletop level to a height inside the bin. Moving them only above the opening does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- Choose straight sidewalls below the shoulder and above bottom narrowing or ridges so both pads contact fully. The yellow bottle is thinner; reduce the opening accordingly to lower the chance of hitting adjacent bottles during approach.
- Before closing, use a side view to confirm the fingers are on opposite bottle sides rather than merely overlapping in the image. Watch for sliding or tilting during a small lift; if unstable, restore tabletop support before adjustment.
- Clear tabletop obstacles with the bottle bottom before lateral transfer. Watch the hammer and tape ring ahead and the drill on the right; orient in open space to avoid sweeping the long bottle into objects.
- Keep enough height for the bottle bottom to clear the bin rim. Lower it only once its horizontal projection is inside the opening. Release into space unoccupied by other bottles to reduce the risk of resting on the rim or other bottles without entering the bin.
